scope: Many keys work better if you use only the keyboard.

topics.title: Tags in the attachments menu
details: The Alt menu in the attachments list now has a Tags group.
It has Tag or untag, Tag all, What is tagged, and Clear tags.

topics.title: Type a command anywhere
details: Press Alt+T on any screen, then type a command and press Enter.
Letters and spaces now go into the command box. They no longer jump in a menu.
Escape clears what you typed.

topics.title: Main menu and setup
details: F1 opens Help in Office tools and in Shut down or restart.
Alt+O opens Options from Office tools, Shut down or restart, and the Media menu.
No or Escape at "Restart the computer?" goes back to Shut down or restart.
The email account question is no longer cut off by the main menu.
Main menu, Help, the tutorial, and waking up now handle the account question the right way.
At the account question, Enter tells keyboard users to press T or Y.
The main menu no longer sends you into Office tools by mistake.

topics.title: Questions
details: F1 says a Yes or No question again on every screen.
Closing Help says what list or question is still open.

topics.title: Email
details: Escape in the To, CC, BCC, or Subject box keeps what you typed.
Control+R, Control+Z, and Control+Y work in the CC and BCC boxes.
A subject like "Save the date" stays the subject.
Delete works in an open message. It asks first.
Keys no longer change your message while the send question is open.
In the attachments list, Delete and adding a file keep your tags.
An empty folder says the same words for every key.
Leaving a draft you never sent no longer warns about sending twice.
Control+F1 in the attachments list says only the main menu.

topics.title: Calendar and Contacts
details: F1 says the add, edit, or delete question again and keeps your choice.
A new contact you cancel with Escape leaves nothing behind.
The guide now gives the right keys for Add contact: Alt, 5, then 5.

topics.title: Files and documents
details: Y and N answer the Delete question in File manager. F1 says it again.
Typing "help" in a name box is now just text.
Saying "Help" while you rename a file gives help. It no longer renames the file.
File keys close Properties first.
One Escape after one letter now goes back.
Alt, Go to, Main menu now works.
A name that is already used keeps the rename box open.
Delete and rename say what they did, such as "Deleted a.txt."
Each box says what to type, and each Escape says what was canceled.
A search says how many matches it found, or "No matches."
Document menu items say in plain words what to type.

topics.title: Web
details: Shift with a number from 1 to 6 goes back to a heading at that level.
A page that stayed open to save your changes opens on the next try.
Escape in a form question stays on the page.
The fields list says the keys once, then only each field.
The page menu shows Control+Home and Control+End for Top and Bottom of page.

topics.title: Media
details: Space in a list menu tells you to press Enter.
Keys in Radio and Podcasts forms all say something.
Space presses OK or Cancel in a form.
An empty preset list no longer shows station actions.
Escape from a list of results first says "Radio menu" or "Podcasts menu."
After you remove an item, the list stays near it and says where you are.
F5 in Radio uses plain words.
The player says "Loudest" or "The audio is silent" at the ends of the volume.
End and the Page keys in the YouTube player say what keys to use.
Escape from the Media player drive list goes back to Media player.
